newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose slightly to 1.667 billion yuan from 1.19 billion yuan with the 60-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said trading remained dull amid market uncertainties including renewed rumours that the central bank would cut the bank reserve ratios shortly.

There were also rumours that the central bank would take measures to regulate the interbank market after Beijing had taken a series of measures to crack down on the stock markets, they said. Officials declined to comment.
The rumours made state banks and other financial insitutions reluctant to build positions, they said.
Traders said the interbank rates would continue to move narrowly in dull trading in the short term.
